description: List the latest World Bank procurement notices for one developing country — open tenders, invitations for bids, expressions of interest, and contract awards funded by World Bank international development projects there. Newest first with bid reference, project name, submission deadline, procurement method, and public notice URL. Useful for finding active bidding opportunities or recent government contract activity in countries across Africa, Asia, and Latin America. Keyless.

limit.description: Number of notices to return (1-50). Default 15.

notice_type.description: Optional notice type: "Invitation for Bids", "Request for Expression of Interest", "Contract Award", "General Procurement Notice", or "Invitation for Prequalification" (shorthands like "bids", "eoi", "award" also accepted).

name: wb_procurement_by_country
title: Wb Procurement By Country
